title: TD Art & Animation
description: For Call of Legends, we streamlined the character pipeline from initial concept art to chibi versions, animations, and VFX for absolute visual consistency.

title: MOBA VFX (Playable WIP)
description: A real time Unity WebGL showcase featuring stylized MOBA inspired VFX, including elemental abilities, spell impacts, and combat effects crafted for immersive gameplay.

title: Snakes And Ladder (Playable WIP)
description: A visually polished 3D Snakes and Ladders experience built in Unity WebGL. Roll dice, climb ladders, and avoid snakes in a relaxing world.

title: Parametric Lightning Shader
description: An optimized real time lightning shader built in Unity generating endless variations from one material, using flipbook distortion to deliver snappy, realistic strikes.
